integrity: The construction, bound, and exhaustive algorithm are included and reproduced; there is no claim of external independent mathematical review or of publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The optimum covers ternary length n at least six, forbidding exactly overlap lengths two and three, and does not determine other alphabet sizes or intervals. The finite upper-bound certificate checks all 19683 disjoint pair assignments.
title: Exact ternary \(2,3\)-overlap-free code size for lengths at least six
